verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs describe a natural-language debugging workflow: "Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix." Supporting docs cover plain-language CLI prompts, agents that run and verify changes in a browser, Bugbot bug detection, and SDK cookbook bug-triage workers. The debugging evidence itself is mostly a one-line docs heading rather than a detailed walkthrough. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the debugging workflow (e.g., debugger or log/stack-trace integration), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language troubleshooting quality.
